name: pr-pane
description: A pane listing the PRs pr-watch tracks: status, CI, votes and what each one waits for, plus your pipeline runs and the issues you follow; open one in the browser, refresh them live.

openPrs.title: Open PRs
openPrs.description: The tracked PRs still open: needing your attention, waiting for others, approved. Off, pr-watch neither checks them nor starts tracking your new ones.

parked.title: Parked PRs
parked.description: The PRs you parked. Off, pr-watch stops checking them until you turn them on again.

recent.title: Merged and closed PRs
recent.description: The PRs merged, abandoned or closed in the last days.

reviews.title: Review requests
reviews.description: The PRs waiting for your review. Off, pr-watch stops looking them up.

runsPerRepo.title: Pipeline runs per repo
runsPerRepo.description: How many of your latest pipeline runs to show per repo, 0 to 20. 0: none, and pr-watch stops looking them up.

issues.title: GitHub issues I follow
issues.description: The issues you opened, commented on, were mentioned or assigned in, or subscribed to in your repos. Off, pr-watch stops looking them up.

minutesRunning.title: Refresh runs and CIs in progress every (minutes)
minutesRunning.description: While the pane is open, the pipeline runs and PR CIs in progress are read again, alone, this often. The refresh button reads everything at once.

minutesRuns.title: Look for new pipeline runs every (minutes)
minutesRuns.description: How often each repo's runs are listed again to find new ones. An ended run is never read again.

minutesPrs.title: Refresh every PR every (minutes)
minutesPrs.description: How often every tracked PR is read again: comments, votes, status.

minutesLists.title: Refresh reviews, new PRs and issues every (minutes)
minutesLists.description: How often the review requests, your new PRs to track and the issues you follow are looked up again.

issueDays.title: Issues active in the last (days)
issueDays.description: An open issue you only joined is followed while it moved in that many days; those subscribed to in your repos always are.
